parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule identifiers, names, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL4651402. Join molecule_dictionary through compound_records on molregno, filter by doc_id matching CHEMBL4651402, and require canonical_smiles via an INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
